license_declaration.open_game_content: OGL 1.0a (Wizards of the Coast), inlined verbatim per docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md §2.2; the book's own _inner_sea_races.pcc declares ISOGL:YES (line 24) and carries a live COPYRIGHT block (lines 35-50, ending in 'Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Races Copyright 2015, Paizo Inc.') plus a real OGL.txt
license_declaration.product_identity_note: Named deities, nations, ethnicities and unique places of the Inner Sea region are Product Identity; the racial-trait rules text itself is Open Game Content. This is a campaign-setting book, so PI place and nation names occur inside otherwise-mechanical trait prose far more often than in a rulebook — 18 of this run's 71 records carry one and had their description field redacted rather than shipped. **Restated 2026-08-12 (SD-29 `decisions.md` 53), and the two numbers moved for different reasons.** Redactions went 12 -> 18 because the ingest now also honours PCGen's own per-record declaration `DESCISPI:YES`, which this book sets on 16 rows; the 55-term blacklist had caught only some of them, by coincidence rather than by construction. Records went 72 -> 71 because `Elf ~ Sovyrian-Born` carries `NAMEISPI:YES` — the publisher declaring the record NAME to be Product Identity — and a name cannot be redacted, so the row is not redistributed at all.
license_declaration.product_identity_source: Paizo Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Races, OGL §15 Product Identity section

screening_method_note: RECONCILED SD34-AT-34-E6-001, 2026-09-01: gate-lane-a wave-24 diagnosed this book's stated records_processed/records_redacted as stale against the live corpus (sd27_book_license_record_counts.rs); records_processed re-derived from disk to 532 (was 153); records_redacted re-derived from disk to 72 (was 22), re-derived from disk (find data/corpus/inner_sea_races -mindepth 2 -name '*.json' ! -name LICENSE.json -not -path '*/_parity/*' | wc -l = 532; per-kind: ability: 104, equipment: 72, feat: 50, feat_generic: 22, language: 4, race_trait: 94, race_trait_generic: 48, spell: 33, template: 9, trait_generic: 96). records_processed is 532, records_redacted is 72. Prior note follows, unedited. Every field of the 82 alternate-racial-trait records this run wrote was screened BOTH against the bounded, documented term list in docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md AND against the row's own `DESCISPI:YES`/`NAMEISPI:YES` declaration, by src/rules_core/pi_screening.rs, which the ingest binary calls per record. The two screens are a union, never a substitution. 22 descriptions hit a term or carried the declaration and were replaced by the marker with pi_field recording which field was redacted; the record's mechanical payload (sets_replace_flags, raw_tokens, raw_bonus_chains) is untouched, so redaction costs prose and not rules. One further row, `Elf ~ Sovyrian-Born` (isr_abilities_race.lst:67), declares `NAMEISPI:YES` and is DROPPED rather than redacted, because a name is the record's identity on every screen and half of its key. records_processed is 82, the real on-disk count for this book's only ingested kind. This is NOT an exhaustive human legal review; it is a bounded substring scan and does not prove the absence of PI beyond what that scan can see. UPDATE -- SD31-E1-F1-001 (race chassis lane), 2026-08-15: re-running `ingest_race_traits.rs` for all books (required to add Bestiary 2's 6-race batch) added 11 genuinely new records for this batch's 6 races (6 ARG/ISR-shaped alternates plus 5 `Mostly Human ~ <Race> ~ Languages`-shaped grant-linked rows), 71 -> 82. 4 of the 11 new records are redacted (`Fetchling ~ Shadow Agent`, `Grippli ~ Defensive Training`, `Ifrit ~ Brazen Flame`, `Undine ~ Triton Magic`, each confirmed by direct inspection to name real Golarion Product Identity or declare `DESCISPI:YES`), 18 -> 22. The failing test's error message lists the first 4 of the full 22-record redacted set alphabetically, not the 4 that are new -- re-checked via `git diff HEAD` on each of those 4 named files: all four (Aasimar/Duergar/Dwarf records) show only their `ingested_at` stamp moved, `pi_marker` unchanged, confirming they were already redacted before this cycle and are not part of the delta. UPDATE -- SD31-E6-F10-003 (equipment gap lane), 2026-08-17: `gen_cache_equipment_gap` added this book's first equipment/equipment_modifier records (71 equipment) via the corpus gap lane (already-compiled book, no hand-authored equipment table) -- every field screened against both SD-30 contracts before writing (the blacklist term scan, `pi_table_sweep::screen_generated_table`, and the declared-PI reader, `declared_pi_at`, over `NAMEISPI:`/`DESCISPI:`), zero unscreened writes. records_processed restated 82 -> 153.
